Etiqa Malaysia Personal Accident insurance FAQs
< Personal Accident Coverage FAQ>
Everyone needs a buddy to get through tough times.
Let me introduce my buddy, the Takaful Buddy Personal Accident. If you or anyone in your family get
into an accident, this buddy here will be the one to protect you 😊️
This plan covers claims that are related to accidents only.
There are 4 buddy plans to meet your different needs. What else would you like to know?

Types of Plan
We offer insurance or takaful plans for the following :
1. Lifeline
2. Eve Protect
3. Crime Shield
4. Weekend Warrior 🔥️🔥️🔥️

What's the difference between insurance and takaful? ️
1. Takaful plans are syariah compliant while insurance is conventional
2. For takaful plans, if there are no claims made for at least a year, and if declared, you will be
entitled to receive the surplus amount (if any).
3. The premium for both are the same.
Would you like to find out more about our plans?

<Eligibility>
To be eligible to sign up for this plan, here are some of our criteria:

1) Policy Owner/Holder
- Age 18 (Minimum) 65 (Maximum)

2) Supplementary Insured/Covered Person(s)
(Entry Attained Age)
- Age 45 days (Minimum) 18 years* (*or 23 years if studying full time)

3) Limitation on Supplementary Insured/Covered Person(s)
- Up to 7 person including the policyholder.

4) Nationality
- Malaysian Citizen
- Malaysian PR
- Residents legally employed in Malaysia. Including spouse/children who are legally residing in
Malaysia.
</Eligibility>
What is the password to open the policy? The password to open the documents is The 3 First Letters
of the Policy Owner's Name + the 6 Last Digits of his/her IC/Passport
 Example: ABCXXXXXX
